instruction: Underline all text that is currently in all uppercase letters.

metadata.explanation: Task requires underlining all text that is currently in all uppercase letters. Evaluator dynamically scans all paragraphs to identify which contain uppercase text, then verifies that ALL text in those uppercase paragraphs has underline formatting.

llm_judge_reasons: CORRECT LOGIC: Metric dynamically identifies uppercase paragraphs using para.text.strip().isupper() - no hardcoded indices (lines 23-34 in docx.py)
COMPLETE COVERAGE: Iterates through ALL paragraphs in document to find uppercase text, then verifies ALL runs within each uppercase paragraph have underline formatting
PROPER VERIFICATION: Checks run.underline for each text-containing run, ensuring complete underline coverage within uppercase paragraphs

EDGE CASES HANDLED: Returns 0.0 if no uppercase paragraphs found, skips empty paragraphs, handles only runs with actual text content

MINOR ISSUE: run.underline check treats None (style-inherited) as False. In python-docx, run.underline can be True/False/None. Current logic 'if not run.underline:' fails when underline=None even if style inherits underline formatting. Should use 'if run.underline is False:' or 'if not run.underline and run.underline is not None:' to distinguish explicit False from inherited None

llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider changing underline check from 'if not run.underline:' to 'if run.underline is False:' to properly handle style inheritance (None values)
Alternatively, use explicit check: 'if run.underline is None or run.underline is False:' with appropriate logic to verify inherited styles
